lines.trans: Kostya, who is the most important in our restaurant?
Maybe our strict head chef?
Or the rich restaurant owner Dmitry?
Or maybe our strict director Victoria?
No, the most important here are the guests.
That is true, our guests can be very different.
Some guests can be too stingy.
Other guests can be very cheerful.
And do they often hug you?
Yes, they constantly say various kind words.
They pay money for this lunch.
Therefore we always smile at every guest.
The guest always remains the most important.

examples.trans: You look like some rich crook.
He is a very rich man.

бывать.gloss: to happen, to be (sometimes); to visit

meanings.en: to happen, to exist, there can be
meanings.note: 3rd person бывает = there is / can be

examples.text: У мужчины бывает не только жена.
examples.trans: A man can have more than just a wife.

meanings.note: the present tense is normally left out: я мэр = I am the mayor
present есть; у меня есть = I have

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.
I grew up in a communal flat.
It is a cheerful comedy about love.

meanings.note: neuter главное, used as a noun

examples.trans: The main thing is, don't worry.

говорить.gloss: to speak, to say, to talk

meanings.note: at home, a party, or a restaurant

examples.trans: All the guests love them very much.

examples.text: Сегодня вечером к нам придут гости.
examples.trans: Guests are coming to our place tonight.

meanings.note: plural only: there is no singular in everyday use

examples.trans: The money is on the table.
I want to talk to the director.

meanings.note: in greetings: добрый день, добрый вечер

examples.trans: I was born and grew up here.

meanings.en: other forms: нас (gen/acc), нам (dat), нами (instr), нас (prep)

meanings.note: Обнимаю вас = I embrace you / hugs (warm farewell)
agrees in gender and case with the noun
остаётся у нас = stays with us

examples.trans: I love our town very much.

meanings.note: платить за + accusative = to pay for

examples.trans: What are you constantly afraid of?
He was constantly late for work.

examples.text: Поэтому я иду на второй срок.
examples.trans: That's why I'm running for a second term.

meanings.note: as a side word: Правда, всё нормально = Honestly, everything's fine

examples.text: Мы рады видеть вас в нашем ресторане.
examples.trans: We are glad to see you in our restaurant.

examples.trans: The most important thing is the people.

meanings.note: 'дать слово' = to give one's word, 'держать слово' = to keep one's word
